entry.content:
1. Static Analysis

Programming Languages / Other

  • dephpend ⚠️ — Dependency analysis tool.

Other / Other

  • zanadir — Audits CI configuration (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Bitbucket Pipelines, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins) for missing security and quality controls such as SCA, secrets detection, SAST, IaC and workflow security, and grades whether each present control can actually fail the build (continue-on-error, || true, --exit-code 0, push-only triggers). Outputs table, JSON, SARIF or Markdown and prints CI snippets for the gaps.

2. Open Source Mac Os Apps

⏱️ Productivity (148) / ✏️ Text (17)

  • Earnote (⭐19) - Records lectures, meetings and calls, transcribes them locally with Whisper and writes structured notes with an on-device AI model.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://earnote.dev

    Screenshots

  • EK Bridge (⭐4) - Menu bar app that lets AI agents such as Claude, Codex and Cursor use only the calendars and reminder lists you choose, over MCP, and asks you before each change.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://github.com/bereciartua/ek-bridge (⭐4)

    Screenshots

  • inlaut (⭐5) - Menu bar dictation for German and English that runs a Parakeet model fully on-device and types at the cursor.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://inlaut.de

    Screenshots

📊 Menubar (151) / ✏️ Text (17)

  • Reprise (⭐4) - Call recorder that notices calls in Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime and more, and records both sides, and the screen if you want, to plain files.

    Languages: Swift

    Screenshots

🌐 Browser (18)

  • Vane (⭐4) - Native WebKit browser with sidebar tabs, Spaces, and Split View, in early development for macOS 26 or later.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://notnaki.github.io/vane/

    Screenshots

👨‍💻 Development (54) / 📦 Git (22)

  • teebe (⭐26) - Shows every git worktree across your repos, marks which ones a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex) is working in, and live-diffs the files they change.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://teebe.io

    Screenshots

🛠️ Utilities (222) / ✏️ Text (17)

  • AI Switcher (⭐4) - Switch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI accounts with named profiles, one-click contexts and per-repository rules.

    Languages: TypeScript Rust

    Website: https://aiswitcher.dev/desktop/

    Screenshots

🪟 Window Management (26) / ✏️ Text (17)

  • Command Reopen (⭐46) - Makes Cmd+Tab restore minimized and closed windows with zero permissions.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://commandreopen.com/

🎬 Video (27) / ✏️ Text (17)

  • IPTVMac (⭐8) - Native IPTV player for Xtream Codes and M3U playlists, with instant search, a built-in mpv player, Picture in Picture and catch-up.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://goelir.github.io/IPTVMac/

    Screenshots

    (1 more screenshots available in the repository)

🖥️ Wallpaper (15) / ✏️ Text (17)

  • Haze (⭐12) - Live wallpapers, a matching screensaver and animated Metal gradients from the menu bar.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://github.com/adrbn/haze (⭐12)

    Screenshots

3. Awesome Game Remakes

Arcade

  • OpenTyrian2000 Enhanced Edition (⭐0) - Tyrian 2000 on Godot 4 and Rust, with HD graphics, couch co-op, mods and a level editor. 🎴

Strategy

  • OpenZ (⭐22) - Open-source 3D remake of the 1996 RTS Z (The Bitmap Brothers), built in Unity on the gameplay rules of the Zod Engine.

4. Awesome Sysadmin

Software / Backups

  • Plakar Community Edition - Encrypted, deduplicated, verifiable, and scalable backup engine with no vendor lock-in. (Source Code (⭐2.1k)) ISC deb/Docker/Go

5. Awesome Ios Books

SwiftUI

  • SwiftUI for Beginners by Ahmad Sahar
  • Swift Charts Beyond the Basics by Natalia Panferova, Matthaus Woolard

Multithreading

  • Advanced Swift Concurrency Training by Jacob Bartlett
  • The Complete Swift Concurrency Toolkit by Jacob Bartlett

Interview

  • Land Your iOS Tech Job by Jacob Bartlett

6. Free Programming Books (Chinese)

其它

  • The LabVIEW Journey - 阮奇桢 (HTML)

软件开发方法

  • 重构程序员 - 阮奇桢 ( 🚧 in process)

Python / Yii

  • Python 教程 - 阮奇桢

7. Awesome Zsh Plugins

Themes / superconsole - Windows-only

  • friesent (⭐0) - Minimalist theme with decorators for username@host, an arrow that turns green or red based on the last command's exit status, the current directory, and git branch/status when inside a repository.

ZSH Tools / superconsole - Windows-only

  • shtab (⭐474) - Automatically generate shell tab completion scripts for Python CLI apps, supports zsh, bash and tcsh.

8. Magictools

Graphics / Texture Tools

  • 🎉 MeshCoat - Fast, offline desktop texture painter: load a 3D model and paint PBR materials directly onto the mesh, then export texture maps. Source (⭐11)

Graphics / Animation

  • 🎉 MeshAnimate - Pivot-style pose-to-pose animator for rigged Blender characters, with a simple timeline and onion-skin ghosts. Saves animations back into the .blend as normal Blender actions. Source (⭐4)
  • 🎉 MeshRig - Rig any mesh in a .blend in minutes: fit a starting skeleton, skin weights and IK. Writes a standard Blender armature that works anywhere a Blender rig does. Source (⭐3)

Collections / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 DailySounds - Searchable sound effects for games, with browser previews and downloadable audio; free for commercial projects under the DailySounds license.

Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

  • 🎉 Slip Sound - Fast, local desktop audio sample manager for searching and organizing large sound libraries. No accounts or file caps, with MCP support. Source (⭐11)

9. Awesome Selfhosted

Software / Booking and Scheduling

  • Chobble Tickets - Event ticketing with QR check-in and encrypted attendee records. The complete product is AGPL-3.0 with no open core and no branding requirement, and it runs as an edge script without an always-on server (alternative to Eventbrite). (Demo, Source Code (⭐34)) AGPL-3.0 Deno/Docker

Software / Manufacturing

  • Orkyo Community - Production scheduling for manufacturing teams — one plan for the machines, people, and tools that run your jobs. (Demo, Source Code (⭐3)) AGPL-3.0 C#/Docker

10. Awesome Kde

Plasma desktop / Themes

  • Fastfetch KDE Splash (⭐1) - A matrix-style boot splash that renders your fastfetch system info with a glitch character-reveal, preserving full ANSI color (256 and 24-bit truecolor).

11. Awesome Testing

Software / Service Virtualization

  • OutageFence (⭐0) - Local HTTP fault-injection CLI by Slanta Cause that checks synthetic sensitive data against declared destination rules, with positive controls and offline reports.

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • Browser Use (⭐118k) - Open-source (MIT) Python AI agent that runs plain-English tasks in a real browser. Browser Use Cloud adds hosted stealth Chromium you can drive over CDP from Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium, with session recordings and live view.

Software / Test Report Diagnostics

  • junit-collision-check (⭐0) - Offline Python CLI that detects duplicate test identities and conflicting outcomes across JUnit XML reports before CI report ingestion.

Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

  • Site Spell Checker - Crawls a live website and flags spelling and grammar mistakes on every page, each shown in context with its page URL. Free one-page scan; the full-site scan is a one-off $99.

Software / Test Automation Frameworks

  • VeriSpec (⭐0) - Spec-driven quality engineering framework that turns specifications into traceable test strategies, native test suites, and continuous release evidence.

12. Awesome Osint

Social Media Tools / TikTok

  • GetTikVideo - Full-size profile picture and latest public videos from a TikTok profile link; saves public videos, photo posts and stories without an account.

13. Awesome Claude Code

Mods / Data Visualization

  • Review Inbox (⭐1) by SummerRiversound - Claude Code mod that keeps GitHub work in a band above the prompt and a drawer: pull requests awaiting review, each summarized before it is opened, the user's own open PRs, and issues that mention or are assigned to them. Picked PRs go into the prompt as review requests carrying a review-style line learned from past review comments.\       

Creative Media / Data Visualization

  • Molecular Animation (⭐0) by Yangyi Liu - A new-film skill, agent guide (AGENTS.md) and Python framework with which Claude Code drives Blender over MCP to turn a scientific brief and PDB or AlphaFold structures into a molecular animation film. The agent checks the brief's structural claims, builds the scene from a script, and writes a production record that tags every beat as experimental, simulation-derived or illustrative.\       

14. Awesome Gemini Cli

Interfaces

  • Alchemist Coder (⭐5) - Open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that indexes your Gemini CLI chats, together with Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build sessions, into one local, read-only full-text search. Running Gemini CLI over ACP inside the app is planned for its upcoming Pro edition; the free edition runs Claude Code and Codex on local models.

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • Concord MCP (⭐608) - Local-first shared work-state MCP server (npx -y @concord-ai/concord-mcp) that lets coding agents coordinate on one repo through presence, file claims, messaging, handoffs and review packets. Works with Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. TypeScript, stdio, MIT.

MCP Servers

  • ppl - Personal CRM for humans with AI agents, with a hosted remote MCP server (OAuth) at https://withppl.com/mcp: Gemini CLI can look up contacts, log interactions, keep notes and set reminders about the people in your life. Free beta up to 1,000 contacts at https://withppl.com/register.

15. Awesome Machine Learning

Python / General-Purpose Machine Learning

  • mojolearn (⭐8) - GPU machine learning implemented in Mojo with Python bindings for classical models and neural training and inference. In identical mode, mojolearn returns the same bits on Apple, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

16. Awesome Django

Resources / Books

  • Django for Beginners, 6th Edition

17. Awesome Mac

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Fotohaus (⭐0) - Open-source photo organizer that works on your existing folders, with on-device face recognition, search and non-destructive editing.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Shiyin - Open-source meeting recorder that transcribes on-device, identifies speakers, and writes timestamped notes with your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

Utilities / Window Management

  • KiwiDesk - Tiling window manager that works out of the box with no config file, has a native Settings app, and updates itself from inside the app.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • IconCraft - Give any Mac app the name and icon you already know. The app underneath does not change.

18. Awesome Mac

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • ateymoori/oh-my-android (⭐60) — Control panel for the Android Emulator with one-click toggles and an MCP server ☆69

entry.content:
1. Awesome Bigdata

Data Ingestion

  • OLake (⭐1.5k) - Open-source replication of Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Kafka and S3 into Apache Iceberg, with CDC and table maintenance. Written in Go.
  • Datanika - open-source ELT platform pairing dlt extract-and-load with dbt-core transformations, plus scheduling and run history in one self-hosted UI.

Distributed Tracing Platform

  • Jaeger - Jaeger: open source, distributed tracing platform for monitor and troubleshoot workflows in complex distributed systems

Columnar Databases

  • KoldStore (⭐6) - experimental PostgreSQL tiered-storage extension that moves historical rows to Parquet and queries supported hot and cold data through the original table; not production-ready.

Benchmarking

  • HiBench Next (⭐1) - Modernized HiBench suite for reproducible Apache Spark benchmarking, featuring 24 Scala/PySpark workloads, Web UI, REST API, and CLI.
  • DeathStarBench (⭐957) - Open-source benchmark suite for cloud microservices.
  • CloudSuite (⭐239) - A Benchmark Suite for Cloud Services.
  • YCSB (⭐5.2k) - Yahoo! Cloud Serving Benchmark
  • TailBench - TailBench: A Benchmark Suite and Evaluation Methodology for Latency-Critical Applications
  • SProBench (⭐2) - SProBench: Stream Processing Benchmark for High Performance Computing

Applications

  • TradeData - API for customs, shipment and international trade data, supporting supply-chain and market analysis.

Search engine and framework

  • Manticore Search (⭐12k) - open-source search database for full-text, vector, and hybrid search with real-time indexing and SQL.

Business Intelligence

  • Beekeeper Studio - cross-platform SQL client for querying and exploring analytical databases and warehouses like ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift, and DuckDB.
  • DAC (⭐795) - dashboard-as-code tool defining dashboards in YAML and TSX, with a built-in semantic layer.

Data Visualization

  • FlexViz (⭐73) - open-source Python library for interactive cross-filter dashboards on large datasets, answering each zoom and selection with a lazy Polars aggregation instead of sending rows to the browser.

2. Awesome Storybook

Examples

  • ElementsKit UI - Storybook

3. Awesome Mqtt

Brokers

  • VelaMQ - Rust-based MQTT broker with clustering, a web console, authentication, topic ACLs, and a SQL rule engine.

Tools

  • MQTT Scope (⭐1) - Desktop MQTT client for Linux, Windows and macOS with a live topic tree, a large-message inspector with diff, and live plots of any JSON field. Website.

4. Awesome Integration

Projects / AI Gateway

  • agentgateway (⭐5.4k) (⭐5.4k) - An open-source data plane for agentic AI connectivity, providing security, observability, and governance for agent-to-tool (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
  • Bifrost (⭐8.9k) (⭐8.8k) - A high-performance AI gateway written in Go that unifies more than 20 model providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, and governance.
  • Docker MCP Gateway (⭐1.6k) (⭐1.6k) - Runs MCP servers as isolated containers with restricted privileges and managed secrets, exposing them to AI clients through one gateway endpoint.
  • IBM ContextForge (⭐4.6k) (⭐4.7k) - An AI gateway, registry, and proxy that federates MCP, A2A, and REST services behind a single endpoint with governance and observability.
  • LiteLLM (⭐61k) (⭐61k) - An LLM gateway that exposes 100+ model providers through a unified OpenAI-compatible API, with spend tracking, fallbacks, and rate limiting.
  • MCPJungle (⭐1.3k) (⭐1.3k) - A self-hosted MCP gateway and registry that centralises multiple MCP servers behind one endpoint for AI agents.

Projects / API Design

  • OpenAPI Style Validator (⭐236) (⭐236) - Ensure that your OpenAPI specs meet your organization's standards with this flexible and customizable style validator.
  • Zally (⭐946) (⭐946) - Ensure the quality of your OpenAPI specs with this linter tool that provides extensive analysis and feedback.

Projects / API Documentation

  • OpenAPI Explorer (⭐351) (⭐351) - Creates intuitive, interactive user interfaces from OpenAPI specs, simplifying API exploration and testing.
  • Zudoku (⭐606) (⭐606) - A customizable framework built on OpenAPI, focused on delivering exceptional developer experiences through quality documentation.

Projects / API Gateway

  • Higress (⭐9.6k) (⭐9.6k) - A next-generation cloud-native gateway based on Envoy and Istio, offering high performance, easy-to-use, and rich plugin extensibility.

Projects / API Management

  • Gravitee.io API Management (⭐461) (⭐461) - A lightweight, open-source platform offering flexible API governance, robust security, and straightforward configuration.

Projects / B2B Integration

  • OpenAS2 (⭐242) (⭐242) - Java-based open-source implementation of the AS2 protocol for secure, signed, and encrypted document exchange over HTTP.
  • phase4 (⭐245) (⭐245) - Embeddable, lightweight Java library implementing the AS4 messaging protocol, including the Peppol and CEF/eDelivery profiles.
  • Smooks (⭐423) (⭐423) - Extensible Java framework for processing and transforming structured data such as EDI, XML, CSV, and JSON.

Projects / Change Data Capture

  • PeerDB (⭐3.3k) (⭐3.3k) - Postgres-first CDC platform for fast, simple replication from PostgreSQL to data warehouses, queues, and storage.

Projects / Data Integration

  • Conduit (⭐617) (⭐617) - Lightweight data integration tool written in Go that streams data between systems using built-in or standalone connectors, with Kafka Connect compatibility.
  • Sling (⭐917) (⭐917) - Fast ELT command-line tool and Go library for moving data between databases, files, and cloud storage across a wide set of connectors.

Projects / Data Mapping Solution

  • JSLT (⭐702) (⭐702) - Powerful JSON query and transformation language inspired by jq and XPath, designed for rapid and flexible data manipulation.
  • JSONata (⭐2.7k) (⭐2.7k) - Lightweight query and transformation language for JSON data.
  • Kaoto (⭐130) (⭐130) - Visual data mapper for Apache Camel with a drag-and-drop interface supporting XML, JSON, CSV, and XSLT transformations. Successor to AtlasMap.

Projects / Integration Platform as a Service

  • Camel K (⭐934) (⭐934) - Lightweight Kubernetes-native integration platform built on Apache Camel that runs integration routes directly on Kubernetes and OpenShift as cloud-native serverless services.

Projects / Message Broker

  • Apache Iggy (⭐5.1k) (⭐5.1k) - Persistent message streaming platform written in Rust, supporting QUIC, TCP, and HTTP transports with high throughput and low latency.
  • Apache Kafka (⭐34k) (⭐34k) - Distributed, high-throughput system designed for real-time data streaming and fault-tolerant processing.

Projects / Schema Registry

  • Apicurio Registry (⭐944) (⭐944) - Open-source registry for API designs and schemas, supporting Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and AsyncAPI artifacts with configurable compatibility rules.
  • Karapace (⭐640) (⭐640) - Open-source, drop-in replacement for Confluent Schema Registry and the Kafka REST API.

Projects / Self-Service Integration

  • Activepieces (⭐25k) (⭐25k) - Open-source, self-hostable automation platform with a no-code visual builder and hundreds of connectors ("pieces"), positioned as a Zapier alternative.
  • Automatisch (⭐14k) (⭐14k) - Open-source business automation tool that connects popular services without sharing your data with third parties.
  • n8n (⭐208k) (⭐208k) - Open-source workflow automation tool with 400+ connectors, giving you full control over your data and integrations.

Projects / Stream Processing

  • ksqlDB (⭐316) (⭐315) - Database purpose-built for stream processing applications on Kafka, queried with SQL.

Projects / Workflow Engine

  • Bonita (⭐178) (⭐178) - Open-source BPMN engine with a designer interface to build and automate complex business processes.
  • Cadence (⭐9.5k) (⭐9.5k) - Fault-tolerant, stateful platform that reliably orchestrates long-running workflows and complex applications.
  • Flowable (⭐9.6k) (⭐9.6k) - Compact, efficient set of open-source engines for automating and scaling enterprise workflows.

Resources / API Specification

  • Arazzo Specification (⭐482) (⭐482) - A standard, programming language-agnostic representation for describing sequences of API calls (workflows) and their dependencies.

Resources / Data Formats

  • YAML (⭐504) (⭐504) - A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.

5. Awesome Lit

Extensions

  • picosm - Lightweight, zero-dependency state manager for vanilla JavaScript with Lit integration.

6. Awesome Open Source Games

Browser-Based / Sandbox

  • The Human Box (⭐55) - Browser civilization sandbox where tribes invent their own languages, cultures and beliefs.

7. Awesome Fonts

Free fonts / Fonts

  • Open Baskerville (⭐392)

8. Public Apis

APIs Covered Under APILayer Suite!

Security

Transportation

Weather

    Auth: No

    CORS: Yes

9. Awesome Rust

Applications / Games

  • 1homsi/thehumanbox (⭐55) - A browser civilization sandbox where tribes invent their own languages, cultures and beliefs, compiled to WebAssembly

Applications / Productivity

  • runxhq/runx (⭐104) - Local runtime for agent skills with explicit authority, CLI and MCP access, and verifiable execution receipts.

Applications / System tools

  • AppachiTech/suvadu (⭐110) [suvadu] - Zsh and Bash history in a local SQLite database with exit codes, directories and the commands AI coding agents run, plus a read-only MCP server

Libraries / Data processing

  • marcomq/mq-bridge (⭐24) [mq-bridge] - Async ETL and messaging library: config-driven routes move data between brokers (Kafka, NATS, AMQP, MQTT), databases incl. Postgres/MongoDB CDC, Parquet on S3/GCS/Azure, files and HTTP/gRPC, with retry, DLQ and deduplication middleware

10. Awesome Zig

Fundamentals / Performance Benchmark

  • jnordwick/zmida (⭐12) - Benchmarking harness for CPU-bound code with adaptive trials, TSC timing, perf counters and text, CSV or gnuplot output. AI-assisted.

Language Essentials / File Format Processing

  • JacobCrabill/zigdown (⭐138) - A Markdown toolset, not CommonMark-compliant by design, that renders to the terminal, HTML and Neovim, formats files and runs in-terminal slide shows. AI-assisted.

Systems Programming / Operating Systems

  • NoamRothschild/hypervisor (⭐13) - A type 1 hypervisor for Intel VT-x, written from scratch in Zig, that boots an unmodified Linux kernel to a userspace shell. AI-assisted.

Network & Web / Web Framework

  • ziex-dev/ziex (⭐398) - A full-stack web framework for Zig. ziex.dev.

Network & Web / Web3 Framework

  • okcontract/oksolc (⭐58) - A Solidity compiler written in Zig that aims for byte-compatible output with solc 0.8.36 on its supported path, optimized via-IR compilation through Standard JSON, intended for development rather than production deployment. AI-assisted.
  • omerfirmak/zevm (⭐21) - An alpha Ethereum Virtual Machine in Zig that dispatches opcodes with threaded code, usable as a library with a pluggable state backend. AI-assisted.

Data & Science / Database

  • antflydb/antfly (⭐470) - A search-and-inference database written in Zig, with full-text, vector and graph indexes over the same table. AI-assisted.

Data & Science / Encryption

  • myzonerocks/gossveil (⭐1) - End-to-end encryption library for messaging applications, written in Zig. No-AI.

11. Awesome Analytics

General analytics

  • stratif.io - Open-source, self-hosted, warehouse-native product analytics. Runs funnels, retention, and path analysis directly on DuckDB, Postgres, Snowflake, or ClickHouse — no ingestion, no SDK. (Source Code (⭐10)) Apache-2.0 Python/TypeScript
  • Privatrak - Cookieless product analytics with visual event tracking, conversion funnels, and custom dashboards. © SaaS
  • OneQuery (⭐17) - Self-hosted gateway for safe, auditable queries for agents across approved data sources. Apache-2.0 Self-Hosted Rust
  • Kirro - A/B testing tool with visual editor and GA4 conversion tracking. 9KB script. © SaaS
  • ExperimentFlow - A/B testing and AI personalisation platform. Features neural bandits, lightweight SDK, privacy-first (no cookies, no PII). Google Optimize alternative. © SaaS
  • Sequential - session replay and product analytics with an AI judge that reviews each session and lists the findings to fix. © SaaS
  • DataSpoc Lens (⭐3) - Virtual warehouse over cloud Parquet (S3/GCS/Azure). SQL shell, Jupyter/Marimo notebooks, AI natural language queries, and local cache. (Source Code (⭐3)) Apache-2.0 Python
  • StackData - Free SaaS pricing comparison tool with pricing data; structured CSV datasets available for bulk analysis. © SaaS
  • Klinky - A/B testing link shortener that splits one link between two destinations, with click counts. © SaaS
  • Replayowl - Open source, self-hosted session replay that runs on Cloudflare Workers or Node. (Source Code (⭐1)) AGPL-3.0 TypeScript
  • Zoho Apptics – Cross-platfom analytics to monitor performance, analyze user behavior and collect feedback for mobile, web, and desktop apps.
  • rrweb - Open-source session replay library for the browser. Records the DOM and user interactions and replays them pixel-perfect. (Source Code (⭐20k)) MIT TypeScript

Analytics dashboards

  • Edalitics - Open source analytics/BI tool. (Source Code (⭐211)) © SaaS AGPL-3.0 Angular/Nodejs
  • DataPallas (⭐80) - Business intelligence platform with interactive dashboards, pivot tables and pixel-perfect report generation. SSPL-1.0 Source Available
  • GoatCounter Dashboard (⭐14) - Modern analytics dashboard for GoatCounter with interactive charts, choropleth world map, and demo mode. Single HTML file, no build step, no server. (Demo, Source Code (⭐14)) MIT JavaScript
  • Conyso Lens - General-purpose data-visualization studio: point it at any dataset and get publication-quality charts across 112 chart types, each with a plain-English, rule-based read (never AI-generated). Runs entirely in the browser; nothing you load ever leaves it. Self-host option available. © SaaS Self-Hosted
  • DAC - dashboard-as-code tool that defines dashboards in YAML and TSX, with a built-in semantic layer for metrics and dimensions. (Source Code (⭐795)) AGPL-3.0 Go Self-Hosted

APIs, Data, and ML

  • cors.dev - CORS proxy for calling third-party APIs from frontend code: prefix any HTTPS URL with https://proxy.cors.dev/. Free without signup or an API key for GET and HEAD requests, 600 requests per minute per IP, responses up to 1 MiB, no monthly quota.

Monitoring

Email

  • DMARCmetric - DMARC report monitoring with named sending sources, SPF/DKIM alignment and plain-English summaries. Free for 1 domain: 10,000 messages/month, 30-day history, email alerts, no credit card.

Supports Raspberry Pi 3, 4, 5 and Zero 2 W.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Oct 19, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Javascript

SDK / Other

  • Social SDK (⭐711) - Typed JavaScript and TypeScript client for posting and reading across social platforms on Node.js and Bun.

2. Open Source Flutter Apps

Productivity

  • akou - akou is a GPL-3.0 call recorder for Apple silicon Macs that transcribes on the device, with no bot in the meeting and no account, and saves the notes to files you own. (Source (⭐14))

Tools

  • VPN Bypass - A macOS menu bar app that sends chosen services and domains around a corporate VPN, or only those through it, and puts the routes back when the VPN reconnects. (Source (⭐127))

Developer Tools

  • Device Hub Pro - Native macOS app to manage and mirror Android emulators, Android phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side. (Source (⭐1))
  • Orbi - Orbi is an AGPL-3.0 system that turns labelled GitHub issues into reviewed, merged pull requests and tagged releases, using GitHub issues as its only state store; Orbi Cloud is the hosted offering. (Source (⭐220))
  • SolidPing - SolidPing is an AGPL-3.0 uptime monitor that runs as a single Go binary or Docker image, on SQLite by default, with a hosted free plan. (Source (⭐17))

Games

  • Patzer - Self-hosted Chess.com alternative: game review for your Chess.com and Lichess games, play vs Stockfish or a friend, AI coach on your own Ollama or vLLM, in one Docker container. (Source (⭐42))

Travel

  • Pumperly - Pumperly is an AGPL-3.0 map of fuel prices and EV chargers with a route planner, free to use at pumperly.com with no account or to run yourself with Docker Compose. (Source (⭐44))

3. Awesome Mysql

Binlog-Replication

  • dbtrail (⭐64) - Analytical replica of MySQL: keeps tables as Parquet files fed from the binlog, queried with DuckDB

4. Awesome Quant

Market Data & Data Sources

  • alphai-tui (⭐77) - Rust TUI - Terminal stock dashboard with keyless quotes, candlestick charts and portfolio tracking, plus optional news and SEC filing views powered by the AlphAI API.
  • prop-firm-rules (⭐1) - Python JavaScript Data - Sourced, dated dataset of prop-trading-firm daily-loss and max-drawdown rules (static and trailing, lock levels, reset times) for 9 firms and 13 programs, with a zero-dependency JS/Python drawdown calculator.
  • canli-pit-lake (⭐0) - Python DuckDB Parquet - Point-in-time market-data lake where every read takes an explicit as-of, corporate actions filter on when they became knowable, and delisted names are kept.
  • Gloomberb (⭐2.5k) - TypeScript Bun - Open-source finance terminal for quotes, charts, news, filings and portfolios, as a terminal UI, desktop app and web app.
  • Fonrex - Python Docker REST - Self-hosted financial data API for European and US markets: prices per listing, cross-checked fundamentals from 18 sources, DCF valuation and Fama/French factors in your own PostgreSQL. GitHub (⭐1)
  • Seiche (⭐1) - Python REST MCP - Money-market and dollar-funding research with public-source collectors, historical observations, separate release and retrieval clocks, and explicit coverage gaps.
  • CNEquity (⭐730) - Python MCP A-shares - Self-hosted China A-share data lake that keeps 55 datasets (prices, financials, capital flows, corporate events, futures and options) in local Parquet with incremental updates, point-in-time queries, delisted-stock retention, DuckDB SQL and a read-only MCP server.
  • yfinance-ir (⭐2) - Python - yfinance-shaped market data for Iranian markets: TSETMC equities, ETFs, indices and option chains, Codal financial statements, TGJU FX and gold, SCI CPI and Iranian crypto exchanges.
  • ws-wire-audit (⭐0) - Python - WebSocket wire-level measurement tool for exchange market-data feeds: frame and control-frame accounting, payload-vs-wire byte ratios, compression negotiation checks, and a documented API-contract audit.
  • edgar-full-text-search-examples (⭐0) - Python SEC EDGAR - Stdlib-only EDGAR full-text search to CSV that splits date ranges to get past the 10,000-result cap.
  • ninjatrader-to-parquet (⭐10) - Python - NinjaTrader 8 .ncd tick and minute history files to Parquet without NinjaTrader running; row-exact against NinjaTrader's own export, incremental re-runs.

Financial Instruments & Pricing

  • vanna (⭐2) - Python - Black-Scholes and CRR-binomial options pricing with Greek-attributed backtest P&L, decomposing each trade into delta, gamma, theta, vega, vanna, and volga via a second-order Taylor expansion.
  • stochPathSim (⭐15) - Python - Stochastic path simulation (Heston, rough Bergomi, Kou, curve-fitted Hull-White and G2++, CIR, commodity and credit models) with Monte Carlo pricing, exposure/CVA, risk-factor backtesting and a model-validation lab producing interactive Plotly HTML reports.
  • CustomDerivative - R - Black-Scholes-Merton pricing, Monte Carlo with antithetic and control variates and confidence intervals, path-dependent payoffs and finite-difference Greeks. GitHub (⭐2)
  • stochastic-rs - Rust Python - Quantitative finance library with 130+ stochastic processes, option pricing and calibration, volatility surfaces and copulas, SIMD/GPU accelerated with Python bindings. GitHub (⭐194)

Technical Indicators

  • Repaint Check (⭐0) - Pine - Records an EMA-cross signal during realtime bars and marks signals absent at the confirmed close.
  • yfinance-ta-patterns (⭐1) - Python - Candlestick and chart pattern recognition library for Yahoo Finance OHLCV market data.
  • technical-indicators (⭐0) - TypeScript - Dependency-free technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, Ichimoku, SuperTrend…) with hand-verifiable tests, open datasets with provenance and reproducible behaviour reports.
  • gamma-seed (⭐2) - Python Pine Options - Daily dealer-gamma levels (gamma flip, call and put walls, max pain, expected move) for DAX, Nasdaq, Dow and gold, computed from options open interest (Eurex ODAX for the DAX, ETF proxies for the US) and written into a TradingView Pine v6 indicator; the method is documented in open studies on the author's site. Website

Trading & Backtesting

  • QuantDinger (⭐13k) - Python - Self-hosted platform for AI-assisted Python strategy development, backtesting, and paper and live trading across crypto exchanges and traditional brokers.
  • ALPHAC (⭐1) - Python - Cross-asset research and paper-trading engine with point-in-time data, walk-forward validation, multiple-testing accounting and a published forward record.
  • trading-research-agents (⭐36) - Python MCP - Autonomous trading system for crypto linear perpetuals in which language models only propose and deterministic rules decide: code computes every figure, prices the full round trip before an order exists, sizes from the operator's risk at the stop, keeps exits at the exchange, and records each cycle with a per-file SHA-256 that can be re-verified.
  • Desic Terminal (⭐33) - Rust TypeScript - MIT-licensed desktop terminal for OKX USDT perpetuals that pairs live discretionary trading with systematic research: realtime WebSocket market data, 24 indicators, a market-wide radar, AI assistants with typed wake conditions, and a bundled Python runtime for 1-minute backtests. Permission modes (advisor / copilot / limited_auto) are enforced by the runtime rather than by the prompt, and demo and live credentials are isolated.
  • Evidence Deflator (⭐0) - Python MCP - Checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls on or before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs once the number of attempts is counted, with an MCP server and an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.
  • OpenBacktesting (⭐6) - Python - Historical single-asset backtesting with pandas-based statistics, technical indicators, and grid or SAMBO parameter optimization.
  • AlphaFinch (⭐2) - Python LLM - AlphaEvolve-style search in which an LLM invents and evolves trading strategies as Python code, judged on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam whose bar corrects for every attempt.
  • canli-backtest (⭐0) - Python - Backtester that raises on look-ahead (decide at close, fill at next open), replays funding and corporate actions point-in-time, and reports deflated Sharpe against the full trial count.
  • tilt-check (⭐0) - Python TabPFN Gemma - Pre-trade check and written audit from your own NinjaTrader trade history: sessions in market time, first trades of the day, re-entries after a loss, exit replay on minute bars, and written rules checked against the chart without look-ahead; never places orders.
  • Optra (⭐24) - C++ Python - Options trading system: one event-driven engine for backtesting and live trading on Interactive Brokers, with pricing, volatility and risk research tools.
  • Sharpen (⭐8) - Python - Open-source agentic-AI quant strategy builder that tries to disprove a strategy before it ships, including Crucible, an alpha-miner (Apache-2.0).
  • backtest-audit-kit (⭐0) - Python - Dependency-free audit toolkit for backtests (no numpy/pandas): detects look-ahead, checks cash/position ledger conservation, flags fee and funding double-counting, and mutation-tests your own suite for blind spots.
  • Lumina Capital (⭐4) - Python - Autonomous multi-agent quantitative hedge fund engine powered by LangGraph, Qlib Alpha158, and Google TimesFM.
  • TokIO (⭐4) - Python Pine Script - Backtest significance checker with published false-positive rates: dependence-robust tests corrected for every variant tried (Romano-Wolf), deflated and probabilistic Sharpe ratios, probability of backtest overfitting, breakeven costs and a one-bar lookahead check, taking vectorbt portfolios, backtesting.py results and TradingView trade exports directly.
  • perpbrain-sdk - TypeScript MCP - Hyperliquid perpetuals order-book fill simulator with fee, slippage and owner-limit checks, an execution-cost breakdown, and receipt verification that re-derives result hashes from the inputs.
  • LR-AutoInvest (⭐0) - Python CLI - Offline daily-bar paper accounts with idempotent CSV updates, price-history revision checks, configurable trading costs, and explainable rebalance plans.
  • matching-engine - Rust - Single-node spot order matching with price-time priority, fixed-point prices and quantities, and optional write-ahead-log recovery. GitHub (⭐1)
  • tradefloor (⭐0) - Python Rust - Generates simulated stock markets for testing trading strategies and AI agents, with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, so orders fill against the book and move prices, and any run can be forked or replayed exactly.
  • tradingview-mcp (⭐5.1k) - Python MCP - MCP server that gives AI assistants screeners, multi-timeframe technical analysis and walk-forward backtests for stocks, crypto, forex and futures across global exchanges.
  • IBKR-Telegram (⭐2) - Python Telegram - Self-hosted Telegram bot for Interactive Brokers that runs next to IB Gateway: position snapshots and P&L tracking, plus option orders from chat commands or webhook signals, each confirmed in Telegram before it is sent, with market-hours, duplicate-signal and position-limit checks on webhook signals.
  • nt8-mcp (⭐24) - C# Python MCP - MCP server and NinjaTrader 8 AddOn that give an AI coding assistant a build loop for NinjaScript: offline and in-platform compile with structured errors, chart and log reads, headless backtests, optimization and walk-forward; read-only by default.

Portfolio Optimization & Risk Analysis

  • portfolio-risk-lab (⭐3) - Python - Uncertainty-aware portfolio optimization: compare covariance estimates, test allocations across risk scenarios, and see the cost of tighter constraints.
  • dca-ladder-calculator (⭐0) - JavaScript Crypto - Zero-dependency calculator for DCA order ladders on crypto perpetual futures that gives the average entry, take-profit, break-even and liquidation price (isolated or cross margin) after every order.
  • Deadlatch (⭐0) - Python MCP - Local, advisory-only pre-trade risk gate for trading agents with 12 deterministic fail-closed rules and a local audit log.
  • stochastly-calculators (⭐0) - TypeScript - Tested implementations of the probabilistic and deflated Sharpe ratios, minimum track record length, probability of backtest overfitting (CSCV) and a seeded prop-firm challenge simulator, each folder giving the formula and its source paper.
  • position-sizing-data (⭐1) - Data - Reference data and worked arithmetic for position sizing across forex, stocks and crypto futures: contract specifications (pip size, contract size, minimum step) for 131 instruments, pip value and 20-pip loss by lot size, losing-streak equity decay and drawdown-recovery tables, plus the risk-to-units formulas with two worked examples.

Time Series Analysis

  • NoiseFloor (⭐0) - Python MCP - Offline financial time-series diagnostics, correlation spectra, change detection, and forecast evaluation with explicit coverage and input-data rights checks.

Prediction Markets

  • oracle3 (⭐476) - Python MCP - Trading engine and MCP server for prediction markets with fee-aware no-arbitrage checks across related event contracts, statistical arbitrage, and live or paper execution on Kalshi, Polymarket, and Solana.
  • OpenThomas (⭐24) - Python MCP - Autonomous weather-market trading agent for Kalshi and Polymarket that learns per-station forecast bias from leak-free hindcasts and sizes positions with fractional Kelly under hard risk limits.
  • pm-hftbacktest (⭐125) - Rust Python - High-frequency trading and market-making backtesting for Polymarket, written in Rust, with queue position, latency and maker/taker fee models applied to tick-level L2 order book and trade data.

Visualization

  • Flowdepth (⭐18) - Rust Desktop - Open-source crypto order-flow terminal with footprint charts, historical L2 liquidity heatmaps, volume bubbles, CVD, and BTC/ETH/SOL options GEX analytics.
  • Kandle - TypeScript MCP - Browser charting app for crypto, stocks and forex with indicators, a scripting language with strategy backtests, alerts, bar replay and an MCP server for AI agents. GitHub (⭐0)
  • OpenKline - TypeScript - Canvas-based OHLCV charting engine with technical indicators, drawing tools, and streaming-data support. GitHub (⭐1)
  • TradeCanvas (⭐22) - TypeScript - Financial charting library for the web, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL: 18 chart types, 111 indicators, drawing tools, live exchange feeds, orders on the chart, replay and backtesting.

Quant Research Environments

  • AxonX (⭐5) - Python MCP - Agent-native quantitative research harness with plugin-based tasks for data processing, factor analysis, model training, and backtesting, traceable artifacts, and CLI and web interfaces.
  • thesis-ci (⭐1) - Python CLI YAML - Linter and CI for written investment theses that fails a number without a filing citation, freezes test thresholds once results are out, and Brier-scores forecasts.
  • easy-stock (⭐1.5k) - Go React A-shares - Local-first AI research workbench for China A-shares: unified market overview, theme radar, limit-up ladder and sentiment-cycle analysis, AI stock reports, portfolio inspection, and agent-based collection of post-market commentary with evidence tracing.
  • AlphaLattice (⭐1) - Python Claude Code Codex - Local research workbench that a coding agent drives from one sentence: dated US large-cap research positions bounded by each date's information cutoff, SEC-filing evidence review, and an investment committee that changes no numbers.
  • SmartMoney-Cub (⭐27) - Python LLM - Local-first, agent-agnostic trading journal and review harness that freezes point-in-time run envelopes and evidence packs, replays them deterministically, and evaluates rule candidates against a frozen 240-case finance benchmark, with no order or broker access.

Reproducing Works, Training & Books

  • cfa-frm-formula-sheets (⭐0) - Training Data - Machine-readable CFA Level I/II and FRM Part I formula reference in LaTeX and JSON/CSV with variable definitions and official topic weights.
  • EPSILON - Python - Open-source backtesting simulator with a 25-minute Assumption Clinic worksheet that teaches students to inspect backtest assumptions using published failed cases. GitHub (⭐204)

5. Awesome Vue

Components & Libraries / UI Components

  • CyteEditor (⭐0) - Rich text editor SDK with Word/Excel paste fidelity, built-in snapshot & version comparison, and official adapters for Vue 3, Vue 2, React, Svelte, Angular, and Vanilla JS.

6. Awesome Roadmaps

Infrastructure / Operations

  • Cloud Engineer Roadmap - Project-based AWS cloud engineering roadmap covering identity, networking, storage, deployment, infrastructure as code, and disaster recovery.
  • Wyrcan Engineering Roadmap (⭐17) - Text-first 12-stage engineering curriculum covering systems, DevOps, cloud architecture, and MLOps with interactive checkpoints.

AI / Machine Learning / Data Science

  • Machine Learning Roadmap - Self-study machine learning roadmap covering Python, mathematics, PyTorch, and ML foundations, with staged concept lists and study-time estimates.

Miscellaneous

  • Knowledge Navigator (⭐5) - Interactive learning map with goal-based roadmaps and chapter prerequisites across STEM and other disciplines.

Articles & Books

  • Frontend Framework Interview Preparation Roadmap - Guide mapping frontend interview preparation across JavaScript, React, Angular, and Vue, with 7, 14, and 30-day study plans.

7. Awesome Parasite

Scientific Journals

  • Bulletin de la Société de Pathologie Exotique - French journal on tropical medicine and public health. The journal ran from 1908 to 2020, when it was replaced by Médecine Tropicale et Santé Internationale. Full volumes are freely accessible from Université Paris Cité (1908-1966, v. 1-59), Gallica (1967-1997, v. 60-90), The Society archives (1994-2020, v. 87-113), and RevuesOnline (2010-2020, v. 103-113).

8. Awesome Go

Bot Building

  • Wisp (⭐13) - Event-driven trading framework for Go. Spot, perpetual futures, prediction markets. Multi-exchange (Bybit, Hyperliquid, Polymarket).

Advanced Console UIs

  • rummage (⭐0) - Cross-platform terminal file/folder picker with fuzzy search, multi-select, and a preview pane.

9. Awesome Open Source Games

Browser-Based / Boardgame

Applications / Web Servers

Google Dorks Tools

Image Analysis / GitHub

  • TrueScreen C2PA Viewer - Free in-browser tool that reads and checks the Content Credentials (C2PA manifest) of a file, with no upload and no account.

Data and Statistics / GitHub

  • NarcoScope - Public-interest explorer of official drug-market prices, precursor flows, seizures, and public-health context, with source links and explicit evidence gaps.

Web Monitoring / GitHub

  • Wayback-Diff (⭐2)

9. Awesome Claude Code

Research & Scientific Inquiry / Data Visualization

  • geo-sleuth (⭐1.6k) by Oldcircle - An agent skill that geolocates a photo with no readable text. Single-purpose Python scripts search and rank candidates using OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view. The answer comes with a camera position, heading, error radius and an evidence image. NOTE: Scripts involve contact with Baidu and Yandex.\       

Providers, Runtime & Integration Infrastructure / Data Visualization

  • Agents Can Communicate (ACC) (⭐129) by Mykola Maksymenko - Local, multi-provider agent communication tool. Adds hooks and a skill to exchange questions and reviews, and saves decisions, verification results and handoffs for later sessions. Each session keeps its own client, model, conversation and permissions.\       
  • Claude Code Local (⭐3.4k) by Matt Macosko - Runs Claude Code fully on-device on Apple Silicon: a native MLX server speaks the Anthropic Messages API, so the unmodified claude CLI works against local Qwen, Gemma and Llama models with no cloud calls. Includes RAM-based model selection, a tool-call parser for local models' output formats, and a verified-offline mode.\       
  • Repowire (⭐265) by Prassanna Ravishankar - A live mesh network that connects Claude Code and other providers so they can talk to each other in real time. Built for emergent coordination. Agents discover each other and share context across project boundaries. Uses tmux sessions as the coordination layer with logical "circles" for peer isolation. Includes a web dashboard and Telegram bot.\       

Status Lines / Data Visualization

  • claude-carbon (⭐211) by Gaëtan Wittebolle - Tracks the carbon footprint of Claude Code sessions, feautring a live CO2 estimate in the status line, computed locally from token usage, next to the session cost.\       

Design & UI/UX / Data Visualization

  • atelier (⭐1) by Ethan Yucetepe - Claude Code plugin with eight design-automation skills driven by one schema-validated brand.json: design tokens for CSS, Tailwind, TypeScript and Figma, social cards, favicon and app-icon sets, responsive AVIF and WebP images, HTML-to-video recording, a WCAG 2.1 AA audit, and a runtime UX audit covering bfcache, INP, dialogs and mobile viewports.\

Writing & Prose Quality / Data Visualization

  • Story Skills (⭐287) by Daniel Dewhurst - Skills for planning and drafting fiction as markdown with YAML frontmatter: story bible, characters, worldbuilding, arcs, scenes, and chapters. Includes a dependency-free CLI whose continuity checker flags characters appearing after their death, payoffs placed before their setup, and stale story state.\       

Infrastructure & DevOps / Data Visualization

  • mirrord (⭐29) by MetalBear - Agent skills and a Claude Code plugin marketplace for mirrord, which runs a local process inside a live Kubernetes cluster's network, environment and traffic. Lets Claude verify changes against real services, databases and queues instead of mocks, with skills for config, CI, database branching, Kafka queue splitting and preview environments.\       

Security / Data Visualization

Agent Orchestration / Data Visualization

  • Agent 007 (⭐4) by bill10 - A self-hosted office with a pleasing pixel-art UI where one manager agent, Billion, takes a mission, posts jobs to a board, and reviews and merges pull requests that Claude Code and Codex workers open from their own git worktrees. Accessible from desktop or mobile.\

Agent Orchestration / SDLC

Features include Strategy Mode (several agents plan a change before writing code), a Reviewer agent that reads each change for regressions, and QA Mode (checklist over the running app).\       

Observability & Monitoring / SDLC

Observability & Monitoring / Session Monitors

Observability & Monitoring / Usage & Cost

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

Requires one of these agent CLIs installed and logged in.

Commands & Extensions

  • assay (⭐102) - Deterministic QA for web pages, with a Gemini CLI skill. assay opens the page in Chromium with Playwright, drives every control, and reports where the page contradicts itself, with no LLM and the same result on every run. The skill tells Gemini CLI to run assay after it changes a page and report what it found. Install with pip install assay-ui, then add the skill file. MIT.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • yoink (⭐5) - Saves and switches Gemini CLI Google logins (oauth_creds.json and google_accounts.json) alongside Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code and GitHub Copilot logins, from a CLI or a macOS menu bar app.
  • aisw (⭐124) - Saves Gemini CLI logins and API keys as named profiles and switches the live ~/.gemini state in one command, alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI. Docs: aiswitcher.dev.
  • LynxPrompt (⭐52) - Self-hosted web app that turns one set of AI coding rules into the file each tool reads: Gemini CLI's GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules and Copilot instructions, 30 rule-file formats in all. Blueprints carry variables so a team shares one set across projects, and the lynxp CLI writes the files into each repository. AGPL-3.0.

Official open-source MCP server (AGPL-3.0, in apps/mcp), hosted as remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key. Paid plans from $19/month with a 3-day free trial. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http unsora https://mcp.tryunsora.com/mcp.

Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, or local stdio via npx -y @bulkpublish/mcp-server with an API key; free plan available. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http bulkpublish https://mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp.

Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth or a free personal token, or local stdio via npx -y tapetide-mcp; free plan available. MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp.

11. Awesome Machine Learning

Python / Speech Recognition

2. Awesome Cytodata

🌟 Purpose

  • Centralize Knowledge: Provide a "one-stop shop" for foundational and state-of-the-art research.
  • Lower Entry Barriers: Help new researchers navigate "Influential Papers" selected by the community.
  • Promote Open Science: Highlight publicly available datasets and open-source pipelines.
  • Standardize Discovery: Offer a professional, searchable index for DOIs and software repositories.

🚀 Key Features / 📚 The Literature Corpus

  • Advanced Search: Real-time fuzzy searching via Fuse.js across titles, authors, journals, and abstracts.
  • Author Formatting: Scientific citation style (Lastname, F. et al.) for professional scanning.
  • Filtering: Sort by year, category (Methods, Biology, Reviews, etc.), or influential status.
  • Direct Access: One-click DOI links to publisher pages.

🚀 Key Features / 💾 Dataset Index

  • A curated table of massive public releases like the Cell Painting Gallery, JUMP-CP, and RxRx.
  • Filterable by description and reference paper.

🚀 Key Features / 🛠️ Software Directory

  • Catalog of community-standard tools including CellProfiler, DeepProfiler, and PyCytominer.
  • Categorized by purpose (Feature Extraction, Data Engineering, etc.).

🛠️ Technical Architecture / 🛠️ Software Directory

  • Frontend: React 19+ (ESM-based via CDN for zero-install development).
  • Styling: Tailwind CSS for a clean, academic aesthetic.
  • Search Engine: Fuse.js for client-side fuzzy indexing of JSON data.
  • Data Layer: Flat JSON files in /data/ acting as a "Local Database" for easy community contributions.
  • Deployment: Automated GitHub Actions workflow for validation and hosting.

🤝 Contributing / 🛠️ Software Directory

  • Read the CONTRIBUTING.md guide.
  • Run python3 scripts/add_resource.py paper or python3 scripts/add_resource.py dataset to add your entry (or edit the JSON files in public/data/ by hand).
  • Open a Pull Request.

3. Webcomponents the Right Way

Component Libraries

  • Accesserty UI Kit (⭐2) - HTML-first accessible web components with built-in keyboard behavior, state handling, and i18n. No runtime dependencies.

4. Awesome Langchain

Tools / Templates

  • Full-Stack AI Agent Template (⭐1.9k): FastAPI + Next.js project generator where the agent backend can be LangChain, LangGraph or DeepAgents (or Pydantic AI), with WebSocket streaming, RAG, auth and Docker setup

5. Awesome Graphql

iOS / React

  • Baton (⭐13) - Relay-style GraphQL client for SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose, with a fragment beside each view and a normalized store the UI observes.

6. Awesome Datascience

Deep Learning Packages / Visualization Tools

  • cvdmaps - Colorblind-safe colormaps and color cycles for matplotlib. matplotlib's default cycle is not colorblind-safe; one call swaps it for an Okabe-Ito palette verified under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia.

Datasets / Book Deals (Affiliated)

CSV and JSONL, CC-BY-4.0.

Similar libraries / Other Tools

Artificial Intelligence

Job Scheduler

11. Static Analysis

Multiple languages / Other

Kin parses supported languages into code entities and their relationships (calls, references, imports, inheritance) and versions them with the source. The kin CLI and an MCP server query the same graph for callers, references, traces and what a change might affect. Imports existing Git history. Public beta.
